select d.trade_id as tradeId, IFNULL(scp.FINPROD_ID, cp.finprod_id) as finprodId, IFNULL(scp.FINPROD_ID, cp.FINPROD_ABBR) as finprodAbbr, d.ps as psCode, d.ps as ps, d.CCY as ccyCode, d.CCY as ccy, d.SHARE_AMT as shareAmt, d.TRADE_AMT as tradeAmt, (CASE WHEN instr('[C9],[C10],[T11],[T12];[C7],[T09],[T22]',concat_ws('', '[' , d.ps , ']') ) > 0 THEN NULL ELSE d.TRADE_AMT - IFNULL(D.FEE_AMT_PAY,0) END) as prinAmt, d.INT_AMT as intAmt, (CASE WHEN instr('[C7]', concat_ws('','[' , d.ps , ']' ) )> 0 THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(d.TRADE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') END)as tradeDate, (CASE WHEN instr('[C9],[C10],[T11],[T12];[C7],[T09],[T22]',concat_ws('', '[' , d.ps , ']') ) > 0 THEN DATE_FORMAT(d.SETTLE_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE NULL END) as settleDate from fin_product cp left join FIN_PRODUCT scp on scp.p_finprod_id = cp.finprod_id inner join TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL d on ( cp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id or scp.finprod_id = d.finprod_id )
and d.finprod_type in ('F16','F18','F22','F26')
AND cp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
AND d.settle_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
